name: 043.4 — seeing it all, and hiding it all
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 043.4: hafen.vr():list() is everything this addon has stood in the world — all three kinds, in the order they were stood, and nobody else's — and hafen.vr():visible(b) is the section-wide switch that destroys nothing and restores exactly what was visible.
